                        Rock Valley Hay Auction (Mon) - Rock Valley, IA
                        AMS Livestock, Poultry, & Grain Market News
                        Missouri Department of Agriculture

  Email us with accessibility issues with this report                                  Mon Sep 14, 2026


  Hay Auction Weighted Average Report for 9/10/2026 - Final
  Compared to last Thursday, Good/Premium Alfalfa 5.00 higher, Utility/fair Alfalfa 5.00-20.00 lower. Grass 24.00-36.00 higher.
  Corn stalks firm. Wheat 25.00 lower. The heavy rains have made it harder to get hay in and out these past few weeks. A lower
  supply and a large buying crowd was on hand. Trade moderate to active with moderate to good demand.

Please Note:
The above USDA LPGMN price report is reflective of the majority of classes and quality of hay offered for sale. There may be
instances where some sales do not fit within reporting guidelines and therefore will not be included in the report. Prices are
reported on an FOB basis, unless otherwise noted.
